newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to bob along within 4,800-4,850.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to bob along within 4,800-4,850.

text.p: A more settled day on the stock market on Friday could make the FTSE 100 index bob along in the 4,800-4,850 range with profit-takers moving in initially followed by bargain hunters later in the day, technical analysts said.

Charging through the 4,800 barrier on Thursday on high volume was a pointer for further advances into record territory, but events over the past few weeks have shown that the nature of the market has changed and instead of a steady climb to higher levels, the journey will be choppy and wild, they added.
By 0731 GMT, the FTSE was down 11.8 points at 4,819.9.
